title: Pepperoni & Bacon Wrapped Pounder Cheeseburger
description: A massive burger wrapped in pepperoni and bacon, grilled to perfection, topped with cheddar cheese.

ingredients.item: Burger sauce or your preferred sauce

steps: Keep the ground beef as it comes from the meat grinder without forming or compacting it.
Cover the seasoned meat with thin slices of pepperoni.
Lay slices of bacon over the pepperoni-covered meat, wrapping the loose ends underneath.
Place the wrapped burger on a grill set to indirect heat at approximately 300-325°F.
Cover and cook until the internal temperature reaches about 165°F.
During cooking, baste the burger with your preferred sauce.
Add cheddar cheese on top of the burger near the end of cooking to melt.
Remove from grill, slice, and serve.
